core.title: Solid Black Passage Door Knob Set, Acorn ST3BI
tags: Smooth black Iron door knob sets

text.description_html:
ACORN-ST3BI, Smooth Black Iron Passage Door Knob Set

Door knobs with a solid black finish are not easy to find especially of this quality. It is easy to install and has a lifetime no-rust warranty. A passage knob, this smooth black iron knob is for doors that don't need to be locked such as hall or closet.

Good for both exterior and interior use.

Also available matching:
Smooth Black Iron Privacy Set
Smooth Black Iron Keyed Entry Set

Features of Smooth Iron Door Knob Set:

  • Passage latch set for 1-3/4" or 1-3/8" thick doors
  • Backset: 2-3/8"
  • Fits pre-drilled doors.
  • Complete with rose and tubular latch.
  • Finish: Smooth Black Iron

Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!



**This item is Discontinued. See available Door Knobs
